::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this page is for

Use this page to find the code behind a BNR workflow or website function. It is
an inventory, not a procedure: follow the linked workflow pages when you need
to run, review, approve or publish work.

This inventory reflects branch `cvd-workflow-hardening` at commit
`a40055288cfa34ef328d39fe8c080425091a80c1`.

## What is included

This reference identifies **160 unique tracked files** at commit
`a40055288cfa34ef328d39fe8c080425091a80c1`.

A file may appear in more than one table when it supports several parts of the
system. The counts below use each repository path only once.

| File type | Unique files | What they include |
|--|--:|------|
| Stata `.do` | 98 | 97 maintained Stata scripts and one generated synthetic workflow command file. |
| Stata dialog `.dlg` | 20 | Forms opened through the **User > BNR** menu. |
| Stata help `.sthlp` | 12 | Help files for the CVD event and mortality dialogs. |
| Python `.py` | 8 | Seven current utilities and one retained first-pass link checker. |
| CSS `.css` | 5 | BNR display styles and three Font Awesome stylesheets from the vendor. |
| PowerShell `.ps1` | 5 | Four current maintenance utilities and one deprecated first-pass reset script. |
| YAML `.yml` | 3 | Quarto configuration, GitHub deployment and the vendored extension definition. |
| CSV `.csv` | 2 | Annual-report contents specifications. |
| Lua `.lua` | 2 | The BNR manual-status filter and the vendored Font Awesome filter. |
| Dependency `.txt` | 2 | Direct Python requirements and the exact tested environment. |
| Windows batch `.bat` | 1 | The local website editing and preview launcher. |
| Quarto template `.qmd` | 1 | The rolling-update landing-page template. |
| SCSS `.scss` | 1 | The main BNR website theme and responsive layout rules. |
| **Total** | **160** | Unique files within the inventory boundary. |

The inventory separates current BNR-maintained code from help files, retained
or deprecated utilities, generated test evidence and third-party extension
code. It excludes ordinary Quarto content pages, published datasets and
metadata, images, fonts, ZIP files and other generated outputs.

## Main locations

Use these folders as the first level of the code map.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Show main code locations"}
| Location | What it contains |
|--|----|
| `scripts/stata/config/` | The workstation path template. The completed local file stays outside Git. |
| `scripts/stata/menu/` | The **User > BNR** menu definition. |
| `scripts/stata/dialogs/` | The forms opened from the Stata menu. |
| `scripts/stata/monthly/` | The six CVD event workflow controllers. |
| `scripts/stata/metrics/cvd/` | CVD metric, linkage, DCO-estimation, staging and disclosure-control code. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/` | Mortality workflow controllers and calculation code. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/` | Rolling, annual and one-off report code. |
| `scripts/python/` | Environment, path, link, manual-status and PDF utilities. |
| `scripts/powershell/` and `scripts/maintenance/` | Controlled reset, clean-up and retirement utilities. |
| `site/scripts/`, `site/_filters/` and `site/assets/` | Website build, display and styling code. |
| `.github/workflows/` | Live website build and deployment automation. |
:::

Keep confidential data, staging packages, local configuration, credentials,
logs and review evidence in the configured private locations outside Git.

|---|----|
| **Update CVD events dashboard** | Step 1: Extract REDCap data |
|  | Step 2: Build cumulative dataset |

|  | Step 4: Calculate metrics for dashboards |
|  | Step 5: Review and approve package for release |
|  | Step 6: Publish approved outputs |
| **Update CVD mortality dashboard** | Step 1: Extract mortality data |
|  | Step 2: Classify causes of death |
|  | Step 3: Build mortality burden data |
|  | Step 4: Review mortality release |
|  | Step 5: Approve reviewed mortality release |

## Shared Stata setup and controls

These files provide the paths, menu and shared event-workflow functions used by
the main controllers.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Show shared Stata files"}
| File | What it does |
|---|----|
| `scripts/stata/config/bnr_paths_TEMPLATE.do` | Defines the path settings that each workstation must copy into its untracked local configuration. |
| `scripts/stata/menu/bnr_menu.do` | Adds the BNR menus and opens the current dialogs. |
| `scripts/stata/common/bnrcvd_globals.do` | Defines shared Stata globals used by briefing workflows. |
| `scripts/stata/common/bnr_step4_stage_metric.do` | Applies the shared checks and staging structure for a Step 4 metric dataset. |
| `scripts/stata/common/bnr_step5_suppress.do` | Applies the shared hospital-only CVD disclosure-control rules. |
:::

## CVD event workflow controllers

These are the routine CVD event entry points. Run the controller for the step;
do not run its internal helpers separately unless a test or maintenance page
instructs you to do so.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Show CVD event controllers"}
| Step or action | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step1_cvd_redcap_extract.do` | Extracts the authorised CVD event records from REDCap. |
| 2 | `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step2_cvd_confidential.do` | Builds the confidential cumulative event dataset and records quarantine decisions. |
| 3 | `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step3_metric_inputs.do` | Creates the deidentified inputs used for metric calculation. |
| 4 | `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do` | Calculates and privately stages the combined CVD metrics and linkage-review package. |
| 5 | `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step5_review.do` | Routes the separate preparation and approval actions for the proposed release. |
| 5: prepare | `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step5_review_expanded_cvd_prepare.do` | Creates the protected proposed public file and human-review evidence. |
| 5: approve | `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step5_review_expanded_cvd_approve.do` | Confirms the reviewed files are unchanged and records approval. |
| 6 | `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step6_publish.do` | Routes publication of the approved event package. |
| 6: combined release | `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step6_publish_expanded_cvd.do` | Promotes the approved combined hospital-and-DCO package and checks the result. |
:::

The event workflow contract is implemented across these controllers and the
specialist modules below.

## CVD calculation, linkage and review modules

The files in `scripts/stata/metrics/cvd/` perform the specialist work called by
Steps 2, 4 and 5. Their names are shown without the common folder prefix to
make the list easier to scan.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Show CVD calculation and linkage modules"}
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `bnr_step2_write_quarantine_report.do` | Writes the Step 2 quarantine report and summary used in later review. |
| `bnr_step4_cvd_burden.do` | Calculates the hospital-recorded CVD count and distribution metrics. |
| `bnr_cvd_prepare_linkage_inputs.do` | Prepares the private event and death records used for deterministic linkage. |
| `bnr_cvd_profile_linkage_inputs.do` | Profiles linkage inputs and records data-quality evidence. |
| `bnr_cvd_l01_episode_core.do` | Applies the first, unique-NRN person-linkage rule and episode decision. |
| `bnr_cvd_l02_l03_episode_core.do` | Applies the name, sex and date-of-birth linkage rules and episode decision. |
| `bnr_cvd_run_l01_episode_diagnostic.do` | Runs and records the L01 diagnostic. |
| `bnr_cvd_run_l02_l03_episode_diagnostic.do` | Runs and records the L02/L03 diagnostic. |
| `bnr_cvd_estimate_unresolved_core.do` | Estimates the aggregate DCO contribution of deaths without one reliable person match. |
| `bnr_cvd_run_unresolved_estimation.do` | Runs the unresolved-linkage estimator and writes its private outputs. |
| `bnr_cvd_profile_subtype_concordance_core.do` | Compares event and death-certificate Heart/Stroke classifications among resolved records. |
| `bnr_cvd_run_subtype_concordance_profile.do` | Runs and records the subtype-concordance profile. |
| `bnr_cvd_estimate_subtype_unresolved_core.do` | Estimates aggregate Heart/Stroke composition where subtype remains unresolved. |
| `bnr_cvd_run_subtype_unresolved_estimation.do` | Runs the unresolved-subtype estimator and writes its private outputs. |
| `bnr_cvd_estimate_joint_subtype_core.do` | Produces joint aggregate estimates for unresolved linkage and subtype. |
| `bnr_cvd_run_joint_subtype_estimation.do` | Runs the joint estimator and writes its private outputs. |
| `bnr_cvd_construct_incidence_rates_core.do` | Constructs annual hospital and hospital-plus-DCO incidence rates. |
| `bnr_cvd_run_incidence_rate_estimation.do` | Runs the incidence-rate calculation and its checks. |
| `bnr_cvd_add_rate_confidence_intervals.do` | Adds confidence intervals to CVD rate results. |
| `bnr_cvd_prepare_rate_reference.do` | Builds or validates the population and standard-population inputs used for rates. |
| `bnr_cvd_create_dco_review_report.do` | Creates the private workbook and summary used to review linkage and DCO estimation. |
| `bnr_step4_stage_expanded_cvd.do` | Combines and stages the hospital, linkage and annual rate results. |
| `bnr_step5_cvd_monthly_reference.do` | Builds or checks the fixed monthly reference used in disclosure comparisons. |
| `bnr_step5_review.do` | Applies the established review checks to the hospital-only metric package. |
| `bnr_step5_suppress_expanded_cvd.do` | Runs the nine-stage disclosure-control process for combined annual CVD results. |
:::

## Combined CVD disclosure-control modules

The wrapper above calls these files in order from
`scripts/stata/metrics/cvd/private/expanded_disclosure/`. They operate only on
private staging data and together create and audit the protected public view.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Show combined CVD disclosure modules"}
| Stage | File | What it does |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `bnr_step5_suppress_expanded_cvd_stage1_combine.do` | Combines the burden results with the annual count and rate results. |
| 2 | `bnr_step5_suppress_expanded_cvd_stage2_dco_support.do` | Builds the private lower, central and upper DCO supporting counts. |
| 3 | `bnr_step5_suppress_expanded_cvd_stage3_primary_flags.do` | Carries small hospital and DCO components into the related annual results. |
| 4 | `bnr_step5_suppress_expanded_cvd_stage4_national_dco_exception.do` | Applies the approved exception for specified national annual DCO aggregates. |
| 5 | `bnr_step5_suppress_expanded_cvd_stage5_structural_secondary.do` | Applies fixed companion protection for unknown sex and mixed event type outside the exception. |
| 6 | `bnr_step5_suppress_expanded_cvd_stage6_existing_closure.do` | Carries existing companion decisions into linked count and rate results. |
| 7 | `bnr_step5_suppress_expanded_cvd_stage7_rate_equation_audit.do` | Checks count/rate consistency and the three-part DCO count relationship. |
| 8 | `bnr_step5_suppress_expanded_cvd_stage8_full_projection.do` | Blanks protected numeric fields and writes the safe display and note. |
| 9 | `bnr_step5_suppress_expanded_cvd_stage9_candidate_audit.do` | Confirms that every required row and field is protected in the proposed public file. |
:::

## Mortality workflow code

The six numbered files are the routine mortality entry points. The other four
files perform classification, calculation, staging and rate construction when
called by those controllers.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Show mortality workflow code"}
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s1_extract.do` | Extracts and standardises the authorised mortality source data. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s2_classify.do` | Applies the CVD death-classification workflow. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s2_rules.do` | Contains the individual classification and supporting nosology rules used by Step 2. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s3_burden.do` | Controls mortality burden calculation and private staging. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s3_calc.do` | Calculates mortality counts, percentages and supporting review fields. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_construct_rates.do` | Calculates crude and age-standardised mortality rates and confidence intervals. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s3_stage.do` | Writes the complete private mortality package for review. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s4_review.do` | Applies final disclosure control and creates the proposed public mortality package. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s5_approve.do` | Records approval of the exact reviewed mortality files. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s6_publish.do` | Publishes the unchanged approved mortality package and checks the result. |
:::

The technical contract is
`scripts/stata/mortality/BNR_MORTALITY_WORKFLOW_CONTRACT.md`.

## Reporting workflow code

These files create, check, approve and publish rolling, annual and one-off
reports. Approval and publication remain separate actions.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Show reporting workflow code"}
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_update_build.do` | Builds and publishes a dated rolling three-month website update from approved releases. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s1_build.do` | Builds the five-file annual-report candidate from selected approved releases and reviewed content. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s2_approve.do` | Records approval of the exact annual-report candidate. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s3_publish.do` | Publishes the unchanged approved annual-report package. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_standard.do` | Composes the standard annual CVD report pages, figures and tables. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s1_prepare.do` | Prepares the landing page and package for a reviewed one-off report. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s2_approve.do` | Records approval of the exact one-off report candidate. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s3_publish.do` | Publishes the unchanged approved one-off report package. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_approve_candidate.do` | Provides the shared approval checks used by report workflows. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_publish_candidate.do` | Provides the shared publication checks used by report workflows. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_disclosure_screen.do` | Screens report counts and supporting values for disclosure review. |
:::

The reporting contract is
`scripts/stata/reporting/BNR_REPORTING_WORKFLOW_CONTRACT.md`.

## Automated Stata tests

These tests use synthetic or controlled inputs. They check code behaviour
without running a live data release.

### CVD event, linkage and disclosure tests

The CVD tests are stored in `scripts/stata/metrics/cvd/tests/` and cover each
major calculation and the complete combined-release chain.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Show CVD automated tests"}
| Test file | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `test_bnr_cvd_step2_quarantine_report.do` | Step 2 quarantine-report creation. |
| `test_bnr_cvd_stage2_disclosure.do` | Disclosure safety of Step 2 outputs. |
| `test_bnr_cvd_stage4_l01_episode.do` | Unique-NRN person linkage and episode decisions. |
| `test_bnr_cvd_stage4_l02_l03_episode.do` | Name, sex and date-of-birth linkage and episode decisions. |
| `test_bnr_cvd_stage4_unresolved_estimation.do` | Aggregate unresolved-linkage estimation. |
| `test_bnr_cvd_stage4_subtype_concordance.do` | Resolved Heart/Stroke concordance profiling. |
| `test_bnr_cvd_stage4_subtype_unresolved_estimation.do` | Aggregate unresolved-subtype estimation. |
| `test_bnr_cvd_stage4_joint_subtype_estimation.do` | Joint linkage and subtype estimation. |
| `test_bnr_cvd_construct_incidence_rates.do` | Incidence-rate construction. |
| `test_bnr_cvd_rate_confidence_intervals.do` | Rate confidence intervals. |
| `test_bnr_cvd_prepare_rate_reference.do` | Population and standard-population reference preparation. |
| `test_bnr_step4_stage_expanded_cvd.do` | Combined private Step 4 staging. |
| `test_bnr_cvd_annual_dco_count_contract.do` | The three-part annual DCO count relationship. |
| `test_bnr_cvd_national_dco_release_exception.do` | The approved national annual DCO disclosure exception. |
| `test_bnr_cvd_stage5_expanded_end_to_end.do` | Complete combined Step 5 protection and audit chain. |
| `test_cvd_workflow_consolidation_v1_0_0.do` | Consolidated event workflow behaviour and interfaces. |
:::

### Mortality tests

## Python code

These current Python files support workstation checks, documentation control,
annual-report finishing and website rendering.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Show Python code"}
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `scripts/python/check-local-links.py` | Checks local links and anchors and writes review reports without editing source pages. |
| `scripts/python/check-python-environment.py` | Confirms the supported Python version and required packages. |
| `scripts/python/check-stata-path-contract.py` | Confirms that tracked Stata path globals are defined by the workstation template and that code contains no fixed local paths. |
| `scripts/python/manual-review-status.py` | Creates a register of manual pages and their review status. |
| `scripts/python/stamp_annual_report_pdf.py` | Finishes the Stata-produced annual PDF, adds linked contents and page furniture, and can extract the public-health update. |
| `scripts/python/check-local-links-original.py` | Retains the earlier whole-repository link-checking behaviour for comparison; use `check-local-links.py` for current checks. |
| `site/scripts/build_download_catalogue.py` | Builds the public Downloads catalogue from approved package catalogue records before Quarto renders the site. |
:::

## PowerShell and Windows launcher code

These Windows utilities perform tightly bounded maintenance or start a normal
website editing session. Read their dry-run output before allowing a change.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Show PowerShell and launcher code"}
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `scripts/powershell/annual-report-public-reset.ps1` | Audits, then optionally removes the specified 2025 annual-report development packages for a fresh controlled run. |
| `scripts/maintenance/cleanup_reporting_hardening_test_artifacts.ps1` | Audits, then optionally removes named synthetic and superseded reporting-test artefacts. |
| `scripts/maintenance/remove_superseded_cvd_step5_disclosure.ps1` | Audits, then optionally removes the named superseded Step 5 disclosure files after checking the replacement wrapper. |
| `scripts/maintenance/retire_cvd_linkage_derived_tree.ps1` | Moves the retired private linkage tree to a recoverable private archive; it does not delete it. |
| `start-info-hub-edit.bat` | Opens VS Code, activates the supported Python environment and starts the local Quarto preview. |
:::

## Website and deployment code

These files control the site build, manual status display, appearance and live
GitHub Pages deployment. They do not calculate surveillance statistics.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Show website and deployment code"}
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `site/_quarto.yml` | Defines the Quarto website, render scope, theme, navigation and pre-render catalogue build. |
| `site/_filters/manual-review-status.lua` | Adds the centrally controlled review-status strip to manual pages. |
| `site/assets/scss/bnr.scss` | Defines the main BNR website colours, layouts, cards and responsive behaviour. |
| `site/assets/css/reveal-font.css` | Defines fonts for BNR reveal.js slide decks. |
| `site/technical/cheat-sheet/cheat-sheet.css` | Defines the Technical Manual cheat-sheet layout and responsive breakpoints. |
| `.github/workflows/publish-site.yml` | Builds the Quarto site on `main` and deploys the generated site through GitHub Pages. |
| `requirements.txt` | Lists the direct Python packages and compatible versions for a supported workstation. |
| `requirements-freeze.txt` | Records the exact tested Python environment for reproducibility. |
:::

## Publication boundaries

- Stata creates, reviews, approves and publishes release-stamped event and
  mortality packages.
- Tables, dashboards and Downloads use approved public files; they do not have
  separate analytical workflows.
- Standard reports reuse approved releases where their purpose allows.
- Quarto presents approved results. It must not recalculate or silently change
  them.
- A local Quarto render previews the site. Only the GitHub deployment workflow
  places the merged website online.
- Correct a release through the version or replacement controls in its
  workflow; do not edit generated files.

Positive counts from **1 to 5** are protected. Zero is not automatically
protected. Product-specific code applies the full rules, and a person reviews
the complete proposed public package before approval.

## After a code change

Follow [Make a safe code change](../maintenance/safe-code-change.qmd). Check the
menu labels, run the relevant tests, check links, render the full site and make
sure Git does not contain private or unintended files.
